entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary:
Bernard Hickey, Economic columnist, business and political writer
This future focused keynote explores the challenges facing Aotearoa and the choices ahead. It places sport and recreation within the wider national context, highlighting where the sector is well placed to contribute and where new thinking will be needed. Rather than offering solutions, the focus is on understanding what’s coming, building on our strengths and identifying the few areas where focused effort will matter most.
